  • Counts represent Pollen grains or spores per cubic meter with Fungi/Mold counts rounded to the nearest 10/m3.
  • Counts are taken for the previous 24 hours, Monday through Friday mornings, and represent an hourly average. Actual levels at any particular time throughout the day may be higher or lower than the average count.
